Looking at this problem, I need to prove that `K.Clamp(x,l,h) <= K.Clamp(y,l,h)` given `x <= y && l <= h`.

The key insight is that `Clamp` is monotonic - if `x <= y`, then `Clamp(x,l,h) <= Clamp(y,l,h)`.

I have access to lemmas `A.Below`, `A.Within`, and `A.Above` from the `Api`'s `Shallow` export, which tell me:
- `Below(x,l,h)`: if `x < l` then `Clamp(x,l,h) == l`
- `Within(x,l,h)`: if `l <= x <= h` then `Clamp(x,l,h) == x`
- `Above(x,l,h)`: if `h < x` then `Clamp(x,l,h) == h`

I need to case-split on the positions of `x` and `y` relative to `l` and `h`.

Let me analyze the cases:
1. If `x < l`: `Clamp(x,l,h) == l`
   - If `y < l`: `Clamp(y,l,h) == l`, so `l <= l` ✓
   - If `l <= y <= h`: `Clamp(y,l,h) == y`, so `l <= y` ✓
   - If `y > h`: `Clamp(y,l,h) == h`, so `l <= h` ✓

2. If `l <= x <= h`: `Clamp(x,l,h) == x`
   - `y >= x`, so either `l <= y <= h` or `y > h`
   - If `l <= y <= h`: `Clamp(y,l,h) == y`, so `x <= y` ✓
   - If `y > h`: `Clamp(y,l,h) == h`, so `x <= h` ✓

3. If `x > h`: `Clamp(x,l,h) == h`
   - Since `x <= y` and `x > h`, we have `y > h`
   - `Clamp(y,l,h) == h`, so `h <= h` ✓

```json
{"HelperA.dfy": "if x < l {\n      A.Below(x, l, h);\n      if y < l {\n        A.Below(y, l, h);\n      } else if y <= h {\n        A.Within(y, l, h);\n      } else {\n        A.Above(y, l, h);\n      }\n    } else if x <= h {\n      A.Within(x, l, h);\n      if y <= h {\n        A.Within(y, l, h);\n      } else {\n        A.Above(y, l, h);\n      }\n    } else {\n      A.Above(x, l, h);\n      A.Above(y, l, h);\n    }"}
```
